name: Tara gum
aliases: E417, tara gum, tara seed gum, tara galactomannan, Peruvian carob, Caesalpinia spinosa gum, goma tara, gomme tara
what_is: A galactomannan gum obtained from the endosperm of tara seeds and used mainly as a thickener and stabiliser.
why_botia: Tara gum is obtained from the seed of a Peruvian tree. It thickens by retaining water, and it is often used together with other gums because they work better in combination. The body does not digest it.
